verdict.rationale: The only first-party history claim is 'Unlimited message history' on the pricing page (slack-docs-43), and it is not tied to the free tier. Community reports say free workspaces have message and storage limits, with history disappearing 'if you aren't paying for storage' (slack-comm-10, slack-comm-15). Nothing in the evidence shows a free-tier team keeping access to older history; the workspace export docs are an off-platform workaround, not retained access.
